intents.response: We operate Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST. We are closed on weekends.
intents.followup: Our support team is available during business hours. Orders placed online are accepted 24/7 on our website.

intents.response: Our products start at $19. Laptops range from $499 to $1,999, accessories from $19 to $149. Current offers: 10% off your first order with code WELCOME10.
intents.followup: Prices on the website are final and include taxes for most regions. Students get an extra 5% off with a valid student ID.

intents.response: We sell laptops, smartphones, headphones, smart-home gadgets and accessories from top brands.
intents.followup: Browse the full catalog on our website, or tell me the product type and budget and I'll point you in the right direction.

intents.response: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders over $50. Express shipping (1-2 business days) costs $9.99.
intents.followup: We ship to over 40 countries. International orders take 7-14 business days and customs fees may apply.

intents.response: You can track your order from the 'My Orders' page using the tracking link we emailed you, or reply with your order number and our team will check it.
intents.followup: Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours after dispatch to appear.

intents.response: You can return any unused item within 30 days for a full refund. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.
intents.followup: To start a return, go to 'My Orders', select the item and print the prepaid label. Items must be in original packaging.

intents.response: All products include a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Extended 2-year protection plans are available at checkout.
intents.followup: Keep your invoice as proof of purchase. Warranty does not cover accidental damage unless you bought the protection plan.

intents.response: We accept Visa, MasterCard, PayPal, UPI and bank transfers. EMI / 0% installments are available on orders above $200.
intents.followup: All payments are encrypted and processed through secure gateways. We never store your full card details.

intents.response: To reset your password, click 'Forgot password' on the login page and follow the email link. To create an account, click 'Sign Up' at the top of the website.
intents.followup: If you don't get the reset email within 10 minutes, check your spam folder or contact support.

intents.response: You can reach our support team at support@technest.example or call +1-800-555-0199 during business hours. Our store is at 42 Innovation Street, Hyderabad.
